transcript: Last night my friend Marie and I saw Incorpo, a new musical about a futuristic corporation where autonomy, individualism and human connection are all threatened by bureaucracy and technology. The music in the show is a really fun techno funk hybrid that uses small ensemble of musicians who are also on stage for much of the show as workers. Although the show is SCI fi, it reflects some of the dystopian aspects of modern day society and the heavy tolls that bureaucracy and capitalism impose on us. Daily special shout out to our friend Kate who's been assistant stage managing this production. Incorpo place its closing performances today, July 8th at Theatre Row if you're looking for last minute Saturday activity. With that, another program for my collection.
